care.title: Make your bouquet last longer
care.intro: Four small habits that keep cut flowers fresh for a week or more.
care.imageAlt: Fresh tulips in a glass vase with floral scissors on a wooden table

tips.title: Cut the stems
tips.text: Cut 2 cm off each stem at an angle with sharp scissors as soon as you arrive home.

tips.title: Clean water
tips.text: Fill a clean vase with cool water and change it every two days.

tips.title: No leaves in water
tips.text: Remove leaves below the water line: they rot and cloud the water.

tips.title: A cool spot
tips.text: Keep the vase away from direct sun, fans and the fruit bowl.

items.a: Call or message us on Zalo with the bouquet, the size, the delivery address and time, and the card message. We confirm the price and send payment details.

items.q: Can I choose the exact flowers?
items.a: Yes, as long as they are in season. If a flower is missing at the market, we suggest one in the same colour before making the bouquet.

items.q: Do you make flowers for weddings and events?
